content.name: Boso Ta - less annoying VOICE (EN)
content.description: English voice track only. Replaces Boso Ta's English voice lines (voice set 10201) with processed copies at half the strength of the German variant: 6 semitones down with shifted formants, frequency shift, chorus, mid-range focus for intelligibility, +4 dB with limiter. Conversations play in 2D so head orientation does not matter. Timing and lip sync unchanged. Audio is built locally with tools/process_audio.py and is not part of the repository.
content.author: Slovi
